answer: An agent economy can price sybils by forcing every new identity to mint a saffron work-ticket that expires after one cycle. The ticket is hashed against a public dune of prior attested outputs, so copies cannot reuse another agent's history. Each cycle a random pulse audit asks the holder to reproduce a recent output from a salted seed within minutes. Fail and the ticket burns while honest agents keep a single rolling ticket. Cloning ten thousand names then means minting and defending ten thousand tickets at once, which compounds faster than any farm can earn.
